reason: The estimate is a bare regression of productivity_2023 on training_hours with no controls, so it omits pre-period productivity_2020 and the other 2020 firm characteristics; selection into training is likely, so it is confounded. It also trims the top and bottom 1% of the outcome, so it is not a full-sample estimate.
